title: The Pink Sequin Mini Dress Costume
intro: Sequins are not subtle and this costume does not pretend to be. A hot pink mini with sheer sleeves, silver heels you can actually stand in, and heart sunglasses for the one photo everyone will ask you to send them. It is a costume on the thirty-first and a birthday dress the rest of the year.

images.alt: Shoppable collage of a hot pink sequin mini dress, silver glitter kitten heels, pink heart sunglasses, hot pink tassel earrings, a rose gold glitter clutch and two pink pumpkins.
Woman at a Halloween house party under string lights, wearing a hot pink sequin mini dress, hot pink tassel earrings and silver strappy heels, holding a rose gold glitter clutch.
